A tuple type the Verilog backend takes, and one it refuses

The Verilog backend lowers a tuple type only when it is plain parentheses with no named field. Type a type text and see the three byte tests and the verdict is_simple_tuple_type gives.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
